body.text:
Everything is now in motion or done. Where things stand:

**Committed and pushed this round** (`40ce7e7`): the CLI completion wave. The ledger's wire format is now JSONL (your approved decision) — one self-describing line per entry, which makes git's union-merge of divergent notes conflict-free *by construction*, proven by a real divergent-merge test; old notes stay readable forever and migrate on their next write. `config` (with the Voyage consent gate), `sync` (explicit push/fetch, never-clobber staged integration, a privacy confirm before any push), `doctor` (11 audits including every failure class this project hit for real — it correctly flagged our own stale index, the known inferred/orphan rows, and the 23 legacy notes), and `export` (Agent Trace interop + `pr-comment` markdown). I re-ran all 533 tests across the four packages and personally read the dual-format parser before committing. **Every command in CLI_REFERENCE.md now exists.**

**Running now, in parallel** (disjoint file scopes):
1. **The MCP server** — `git for-ai mcp`, exposing `ask`, `blame_why`, `show`, `log_intent`, `doctor`, and the schema-validated `annotate` write tool over stdio via the official SDK. When this lands, any Claude Code instance can be pointed at a repo and natively read *and write* the intent layer — the vision's centerpiece.
2. **Your review-page redesign (task #14)** — ask panel promoted to the top as the primary interaction, human-first hierarchy (summaries, evidence, risk flags up front; internals dropped from the page since agents read `--json`), attention queue reshaped as an inbox, verified in a real browser before it reports.

When both land and pass verification, the entire board is clear: a feature-complete CLI, agents as first-class citizens via MCP, and a review surface designed for exactly one reader — you. I'll report with both verifications.
MCP server landed. Verifying — build, CLI suite, and a check of the one seam I want to see myself (the test-embedder env gate must be inert in production):

attributes.command: cd C:/src/git-for-ai/packages/cli && pnpm build 2>&1 | tail -2 && pnpm vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests \|" ; grep -n -B2 -A6 "GIT_FOR_AI_MCP_TEST_EMBEDDER" src/commands/mcp.ts | head -20
cd C:/src/git-for-ai/packages/cli && pnpm vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests "

cd C:/src/git-for-ai && git add packages/cli/src/commands/mcp.ts packages/cli/src/commands/mcp.test.ts packages/cli/src/bin.ts packages/cli/package.json README.md pnpm-lock.yaml && git commit -q -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add `git for-ai mcp`: the intent layer as native MCP tools

PLAN_2026-07-18.md §2.3 delivered — the piece that makes agents
first-class citizens. A stdio MCP server (official SDK, pinned 1.29.0)
exposing six tools, each a thin wrapper over the exact pure function
its CLI command already wraps (zero logic duplication, no shelling
out): ask, blame_why, show, log_intent, doctor (all readOnlyHint,
inheriting the non-minting read paths), and annotate — the one WRITE
tool, flagged as such, same schema-validated partial-entry contract as
annotate --stdin (unknown keys rejected loudly). Every thrown error
maps to an MCP tool error carrying the CLI's actionable message chain
(init -> reindex -> reindex --full); the server never crashes and
never touches stdout outside the protocol.

One documented test seam (GIT_FOR_AI_MCP_TEST_EMBEDDER) lets spawned-
server tests use the deterministic bag-of-words embedder across the
process boundary; dynamically imported, production never loads it.

15 new tests: the BUILT server driven over real stdio by the SDK's
own client (tool listing, reads, the annotate write round-trip, tool-
error cases; both key env vars pinned empty so no real key is ever
spent), plus in-process mocked-fetch synthesis. CLI suite 208 passing,
independently re-verified. Dogfooded over real stdio on this repo:
log_intent and show returned the actual history with full ledger data.

README: MCP row + `claude mcp add git-for-ai -- git-for-ai mcp`
registration snippet; stale "planned next" line corrected.

Implemented by a background Fable 5 agent; reviewed (test-seam gating
inspected) and committed by the orchestrating session.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git log --oneline -1

summary: claude-code session: 9 tool execution(s), 2 model turn(s) for commit "Add `git for-ai mcp`: the intent layer as native MCP tools".
